description: Scala class implementing a persistence engine that stores data in files on disk, with methods for persisting, unpersisting, and reading data, utilizing optional compression and serialization.

classes.name: FileSystemPersistenceEngine
classes.description: A persistence engine that stores application and worker data in files within a specified directory, supporting serialization and optional compression.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes an object and writes it to a file with the given name in the directory.

methods.name: unpersist
methods.description: Deletes the file associated with the given name from the directory.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads files with names starting with the given prefix, deserializes their contents, and returns a sequence of objects.

methods.name: serializeIntoFile
methods.description: Serializes a value and writes it into a specified file, applying compression if configured.

methods.name: deserializeFromFile
methods.description: Reads and deserializes an object from a specified file, applying decompression if configured.
